scope: Full-episode staged observation feedback without MPC; experimental, not promoted

episodes.name: 18 - Blue bin - staged observation feedback v2
episodes.method_label: STAGED OBSERVATION FEEDBACK - NO MPC - EXPERIMENTAL
episodes.stage_status: Preserved motion and phase clock; bounded force-stage feedback from actual object pose/twist and matched physical contacts. 858 frames, 28.57 s. No prediction, object assistance or resets.
episodes.model_notes: Active v2 with current-state kinematic refresh, saved source snapshot and identical gains to v1. Force QP updates during physics; this viewer only replays the recorded result. Original retargeting on the left; staged feedback on the right; orange ghost/path is original intended motion.
display_limitations: Not promoted: position RMS 48.48 to 51.53 mm, orientation RMS 5.91 to 6.02 degrees versus preserved correction on port 8087.
Sixteen bounded-rate solves required fallback; measured residual rate exceeds its declared bound. Peak requested torque is 2.273 times capacity; actual torques remain clipped.
No contact reacquisition: fixed saved grasp family and trajectory. Selected unmatched contacts have zero additional object-wrench authority.
Upper body and object are dynamic; pelvis follows the externally supported recorded path. Walking/balance are not simulated. Source visual mesh and convex physics pieces differ.
